description: This file contains shell functions for configuring network interfaces, switches, LEDs, wireless settings, system credentials, and other device-specific configurations in an embedded or router environment. It defines various functions to generate or modify JSON-based configuration structures used in system initialization scripts.

methods.name: json_select_array
methods.description: Selects a JSON array by key, adds array if not present.

methods.name: json_select_object
methods.description: Selects a JSON object by key, adds object if not present.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface
methods.description: Configures network interface parameters in JSON.

methods.name: ucidef_set_board_id
methods.description: Sets the board ID in JSON config.

methods.name: ucidef_set_model_name
methods.description: Sets the model name in JSON config.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_lan
methods.description: Configures LAN interface with device and protocol.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_wan
methods.description: Configures WAN interface with device and protocol.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interfaces_lan_wan
methods.description: Configures both LAN and WAN interfaces.

methods.name: _ucidef_set_network_device_common
methods.description: Helper for setting network device attributes.

methods.name: ucidef_set_network_device_mac
methods.description: Sets MAC address for network device.

methods.name: ucidef_set_network_device_path
methods.description: Sets path attribute for network device.

methods.name: ucidef_set_network_device_path_port
methods.description: Sets path and port attributes for network device.

methods.name: ucidef_set_network_device_gro
methods.description: Sets GRO attribute for network device.

methods.name: ucidef_set_network_device_conduit
methods.description: Sets conduit attribute for network device.

methods.name: _ucidef_add_switch_port
methods.description: Adds a switch port configuration object.

methods.name: _ucidef_finish_switch_roles
methods.description: Finalizes switch roles and interface configurations.

methods.name: ucidef_add_switch
methods.description: Adds a switch configuration with ports and roles.

methods.name: ucidef_add_switch_attr
methods.description: Adds an attribute to switch configuration.

methods.name: ucidef_add_switch_port_attr
methods.description: Adds an attribute to a switch port.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_macaddr
methods.description: Sets MAC address for a network interface.

methods.name: ucidef_set_led_ataport
methods.description: Sets LED trigger for ATA port.

methods.name: _ucidef_set_led_timer
methods.description: Helper for setting LED timer behavior.

methods.name: ucidef_set_root_password_plain
methods.description: Sets root password in plain text.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_netdev_range
methods.description: Configures a range of network device interfaces.

methods.name: board_config_update
methods.description: Initializes or updates the board configuration JSON.

methods.name: board_config_flush
methods.description: Saves the current JSON configuration to file.
